notes.title: Alpha 2a Bugfixes Release
notes.notes:
New Feature: Global leaderboards around view, shows what rank you are when you are not in the top 10 including two spots above and below you.

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] No audio on load
[*] Laser pointer stops working after hitting the Steam button
[*] Menu button stop working
[*] Tweaks to the Space Track colliders to close up holes that allowed you to escape (This will also reset the leaderboards for the Space Track)
[/list]

We also have a public trello page where you can suggest new ideas and vote on current ones. https://trello.com/b/i6tYoda2
